import openpyxl

path = 'sales_data.xlsx'
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(path)
ws = wb.active
print("Active sheet:", ws.title, "dims:", ws.dimensions, "max_row:", ws.max_row, "max_col:", ws.max_column)

# Find header row (first row with any string cell)
header_row = None
for r in range(1, min(ws.max_row, 5) + 1):
    vals = [ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value for c in range(1, ws.max_column + 1)]
    if any(isinstance(v, str) for v in vals):
        header_row = r
        break
if header_row is None:
    raise SystemExit("No header row found")
headers = {c: ws.cell(row=header_row, column=c).value for c in range(1, ws.max_column + 1)}
print("Header row:", header_row)
for c, v in headers.items():
    print("  col", c, "=", repr(v))

def norm(v):
    if v is None:
        return ""
    return str(v).strip().lower()

# Locate revenue and cost columns by header name
rev_col = cost_col = None
for c, v in headers.items():
    n = norm(v)
    if rev_col is None and any(k in n for k in ("revenue", "sales", "amount", "price", "income", "total")):
        rev_col = c
    if cost_col is None and any(k in n for k in ("cost", "cogs", "expense", "purchase")):
        cost_col = c
    if rev_col and cost_col:
        break

print("Revenue col:", rev_col, "Cost col:", cost_col)
if rev_col is None or cost_col is None:
    raise SystemExit("Could not locate revenue and cost columns")

new_col = ws.max_column + 1
header_cell = ws.cell(row=header_row, column=new_col, value="Profit Margin (%)")
header_cell.font = openpyxl.styles.Font(bold=True)

first_data = header_row + 1
last_data = ws.max_row
for r in range(first_data, last_data + 1):
    rev = ws.cell(row=r, column=rev_col).value
    cost = ws.cell(row=r, column=cost_col).value
    if rev is None and cost is None:
        continue
    cell = ws.cell(row=r, column=new_col)
    cell.value = f"=IFERROR(({ws.cell(row=r, column=rev_col).coordinate}-{ws.cell(row=r, column=cost_col).coordinate})/{ws.cell(row=r, column=rev_col).coordinate},0)"
    cell.number_format = '0.0%;-0.0%;-'

ws.column_dimensions[openpyxl.utils.get_column_letter(new_col)].width = 16
wb.save(path)
print("Saved. New column:", openpyxl.utils.get_column_letter(new_col), "rows:", first_data, "-", last_data)
